disorder-name.detail: First episode psychosis; FDOPA_01 dataset, N=25 patients. Patients met ICD-10 criteria for psychotic disorder and DSM-IV axis I criteria for SCZ, scanned shortly after first psychosis episode. Medication naïve or free (no medication at scanning with at least 6 months washout for oral medication or 6 months for depot medication).
disorder-name.supporting_text: "The FDOPA_01 dataset included FEP patients who were recruited if they had a diagnosis of psychotic disorder according to ICD 10 criteria" "First Episode Patients (FEP) are patients scanned shortly after the first psychosis episode" "DSM-IV axis I criteria for SCZ...at least one current or previous psychotic episode (duration of illness, median [IQR]: 24 [24] months), medication naïve or free"
disorder-name.location: Giacomel2025.pdf.md: Methods / Study datasets, L85; Table 1 caption, L89; Table 1, L93

dataset-of-origin.detail: FDOPA_01 from a single imaging site (Invicro, London), scanner: Hi-Rez Biograph 6 (PET/CT). Data from previous [18F]FDOPA PET studies. No standard public dataset name; the authors label this dataset FDOPA_01.

age.detail: Patient-only age not reported separately. Table 1 reports combined FDOPA_01 dataset demographics (61 HC + 25 FEP patients, N≈86–87 total): mean 26.25, SD 5.18 years. Min and max not reported.

sex.detail: Patient-only sex not reported separately. Table 1 reports combined FDOPA_01 dataset demographics (61 HC + 25 FEP patients, N≈86–87 total): 32F (36.7%) / 55M (63.2%).

disorder-name.detail: Schizophrenia; combined from three datasets (total N=84): FDOPA_02 (N=24, chronic SCZ, DSM-IV), FDOPA_03 (N=24, chronic SCZ paranoid subtype, DSM-IV), FDOPA_04 (N=36, mixed FEP+chronic, DSM-V criteria for SCZ or schizophreniform disorders). FDOPA_04 also includes some patients with schizophreniform disorder (SZF), but the paper refers to this cohort as 'patients with SCZ'. The paper does not provide separate counts for SCZ vs SZF within FDOPA_04.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "The FDOPA_02 dataset included patients with a DSM-IV diagnosis of SCZ" "Patients in the FDOPA_03 dataset were also patients who met the DSM-IV criteria for SCZ, paranoid subtype. All patients were taking antipsychotic medication at the time of scanning other than clozapine" "the FDOPA_04 dataset included patients who met the DSM-V criteria for SCZ or schizophreniform disorders" "we applied the [18F]FDOPA PET NM on an independent dataset of patients with SCZ (FDOPA_04)"
disorder-name.location: Giacomel2025.pdf.md: Methods / Study datasets, L105; Table 1, L93; Results, L318

dataset-of-origin.detail: Three datasets from three imaging sites (3 sites): FDOPA_02 (Bundang Hospital, South Korea; Biograph 40 TruePoint PET/CT), FDOPA_03 (MRC Cyclotron Unit, London; ECAT HR+ 962 PET/CT), FDOPA_04 (Invicro, London; Hi-Rez Biograph 6 PET/CT). All from previous [18F]FDOPA PET studies. No standard public dataset names; the authors label them FDOPA_02, FDOPA_03, FDOPA_04.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "Imaging Site: South Korea" "MRC Cyclotron Unit" "Invicro" "Scanner (scanner type): Biograph 40 TruePoint (PET/CT)" "ECAT HR + 962 (PET/CT)" "Hi-Rez Biograph 6 (PET/CT)"

age.detail: Patient-only age available only for FDOPA_04 (N=36): mean 30.63, SD 10.91 years. FDOPA_02 and FDOPA_03 report only combined HC+patients age per dataset: FDOPA_02 (N=50 combined, 26 HC + 24 patients; mean 29.00, SD 8.70), FDOPA_03 (N≈34 combined, 12 HC + 24 patients; mean 44.52, SD 9.97). Weighted mean across all 84 SCZ patients cannot be calculated because patient-only values for FDOPA_02 and FDOPA_03 are not reported. The reported answer covers FDOPA_04 only (36 of 84 patients). Min and max not reported for any dataset.

sex.detail: Patient-only sex available only for FDOPA_04 (N=36): 8F (22.2%) / 28M (77.8%). FDOPA_02 and FDOPA_03 report only combined HC+patients sex per dataset: FDOPA_02 (N=50 combined; 17F [34.0%] / 33M [66.0%]), FDOPA_03 (N≈34 combined; 21F [58.9%] / 13M [36.2%]). Overall SCZ patient-only sex cannot be calculated because patient-only values for FDOPA_02 and FDOPA_03 are not reported. The reported answer covers FDOPA_04 only (36 of 84 patients).
